journey.title: Start a packet the desk cannot classify, or relaunch it
journey.purpose: A packet the desk reads as unknown can still be started on the operator's word that it never ran, which the API checks against every session it can read and records; otherwise it is relaunched as a new commission. The two manual messages stay hidden until then.

steps.intent: See the packet among the packets that launch as they are.
Read why its state is unknown and tick that it was never started, or tap Relaunch as a new commission.
With the assertion made, read the two messages to paste by hand if automatic launch is unavailable.
After a failed start, discard with a reason and relaunch as a new commission.
